rationale: Resolve the generic Wind Facility placeholder as Mesteño Wind Project and replace its unsupported InfraRed Infrastructure Fund VI attribution with the regulatory ownership chain. Texas PUCT records establish a May 29, 2024 closing through Mesteno Aggregator LLC, owned 3.48% directly by InfraRed Energy Transition Fund A LP and 96.52% indirectly by InfraRed Energy Transition Fund B LP through Mesteno HoldCo LLC. InfraRed announced the acquisition from Duke Energy on May 30, 2024. No later owner exit or signed ownership change was identified through September 1, 2026.

companyFieldUpdates.name: Mesteño Wind Project
companyFieldUpdates.description: Mesteño Wind Project is a 201.6 MW onshore wind facility in Starr County, Texas, commonly described as a 202 MW project. The facility comprises 56 Vestas V136-3.6 MW turbines, began commercial operation in 2019 and participates in the ERCOT market. InfraRed Capital Partners acquired the project company, Mesteno Windpower, LLC, from Duke Energy through Mesteno Aggregator LLC on May 29, 2024. Current regulatory records show InfraRed Energy Transition Fund A LP holding 3.48% directly in the aggregator and InfraRed Energy Transition Fund B LP holding 96.52% indirectly through Mesteno HoldCo LLC. The two positions together represent 100% InfraRed-controlled ownership. No later owner exit or signed ownership change was identified through September 1, 2026.
